pegasus_flythroughsforunity6.description_text: Bring your Unity scenes to life with Pegasus, a flythrough and camera animation tool designed for creating cinematic paths through your environments. Create camera routes using splines, control the movement and direction of your camera, and build flythroughs for terrains, interiors and mesh-based scenes. Pegasus can also be used to move other objects along paths, making it useful for creating controlled movements through your scenes. With support for cinematic-style camera work and integration with Gaia, you can set up engaging environment flythroughs and capture the movement of your scene with greater control. ✨

deepunderwater.description_text: Take your scene beneath the surface with an underwater environment featuring terrain, rocks, vegetation and a sunken submarine. Deep Underwater includes a 765 x 765 m example map designed around an underwater setting. The environment combines terrain with underwater elements and a collection of assets for building your own submerged scenes. The pack includes fully customized materials, new and aged looks using vertex paint, LODs and lightmap UVs, along with terrain tessellation. With its underwater terrain and environment assets, Deep Underwater gives you a complete starting point for creating scenes beneath the water.

infinitunesmusiccollectiona_medievalreal.human_name: InfiniTUNES Music Collection A - Medieval Real Instrument Songs
infinitunesmusiccollectiona_medievalreal.description_text: Add medieval-inspired real-instrument music to your Unity projects with InfiniTUNES Music Collection A. The collection contains music tracks that can be played directly or rearranged through their individual instrument tracks, giving you different possibilities for combining the music. The tracks are based on real instruments and are composed by Theodore Tsoukalas of the ARTnGAME team. The included InfiniTUNE system can combine individual tracks and control their volume, allowing different combinations of the available music parts. Use the tracks individually or experiment with the instrument layers to create different musical arrangements for your scenes.

gaiabiomesspawnerpack_baldinoboy.description_text: Integrate Baldinoboy nature and environment assets into your Gaia workflow with this dedicated spawner pack. It provides Gaia spawners configured for compatible Baldinoboy assets, allowing them to be used within Gaia terrain, biome, and procedural environment workflows. HIGHLIGHTS Gaia Integration – Designed for use with Gaia Baldinoboy – Configured for compatible Baldinoboy assets Spawner Integration – Gaia spawners for the supported asset collection ⚙️ Procedural Workflow – Use supported assets with Gaia’s spawning system ️ Biome Workflow – Suitable for Gaia terrain and biome setups Asset Integration – Connects Baldinoboy assets with Gaia workflows

switchinputdeviceandgamepadmouse.description_text: Create a smoother cross-platform input experience with Switch Input Device & Gamepad Mouse. This Unity tool helps detect and switch between input devices at runtime, making it easier to build interfaces that adapt to different controllers and input methods. Designed for projects using gamepads, mouse controls, and modern UI systems. HIGHLIGHTS Device Switching – Detect and switch between input devices Gamepad Support – Designed for controller-based gameplay ️ Gamepad Mouse – Use gamepad input for mouse-style interaction Input Detection – Identify active runtime input devices ️ UI Controls – Adapt interfaces to different input methods ⚙️ Runtime Input – Manage device changes during gameplay Cross Platform – Useful for multi-platform projects

infernaldestroyer.description_text: Unleash destruction with Infernal Destroyer, a brutal skeletal demon created for intense fantasy, action, horror, and RPG experiences. Its imposing creature design, detailed PBR materials, powerful weapon, and intimidating appearance make it a strong choice for elite enemies, combat encounters, and boss battles. HIGHLIGHTS Brutal Infernal Design – Intimidating skeletal demon warrior ⚔️ Weapon Included – Built for combat-focused characters Enemy & Boss Ready – Ideal for challenging encounters ARKit Blendshapes – Supports expressive facial animation ️ PBR Materials – Detailed surfaces for realistic rendering Game Ready – Designed for real-time gameplay Render Pipeline Support – Built-in, URP & HDRP compatible

tooneffectsmakerurp_animeandcartoonfx.human_name: Toon Effects Maker URP - Anime & Cartoon FX
tooneffectsmakerurp_animeandcartoonfx.description_text: Create stylized visual effects with Toon Effects Maker URP, a framework focused on cartoon and anime-style effects in Unity. ✨ Build effects using the included Effect Maker, particle tools, aura effects, beams, projectile effects, sprite-sheet generation and motion recording. The package also includes a library of 200+ pre-made effects that can be used directly or as a starting point for your own creations. ⚡ Explore effects such as lightning, tornadoes, ground cracks, waterfalls, dissolves and toon-style lighting. A Toon Ocean system is also included for creating dynamic ocean, water, ice or lava effects.

arcadevehicleai.description_text: Bring arcade-style vehicle AI into your Unity project! Arcade Vehicle AI is designed to help you implement AI-controlled vehicles with an arcade-style approach. It can be used for vehicle AI behavior in racing and other vehicle-based gameplay, giving you a straightforward starting point for adding AI-driven vehicles to your project. ⚙️ The tool focuses on arcade vehicle AI and is built to work alongside vehicle-based projects. Whether you are working on a racing game or experimenting with AI-controlled cars, this asset provides a simple way to add vehicle AI behavior to your Unity workflow. Build your vehicle gameplay around the AI system and customize it according to the needs of your project.

skullbearer.description_text: Bring a dark and intimidating presence to your game with The Skull Bearer. This detailed fantasy character is designed for developers creating horror, action, RPG, and dark fantasy experiences. With a distinctive skeletal design, weapon, realistic PBR materials, facial blendshapes, and a strong boss-like appearance, The Skull Bearer can become a memorable enemy or powerful character within your game world. HIGHLIGHTS ☠️ Distinctive Design – Menacing skeletal fantasy character ⚔️ Weapon Included – Ready for combat-focused gameplay Enemy & Boss Ready – Perfect for powerful encounters ARKit Blendshapes – Supports expressive facial animation ️ PBR Materials – Detailed materials for realistic rendering Game Ready – Designed for real-time gameplay Modular Character – Flexible setup for customization Render Pipeline Support – Built-in, URP & HDRP compatible

lookouttowerprops.description_text: Build and detail a lookout tower scene with a dedicated collection of tower-themed props. This pack includes the tower mesh along with more than 100 lookout-themed props, giving you a range of objects to populate and detail your scene. The included materials can be adjusted for a worn look, while high quality textures add detail to the assets. Lightmap UVs are also included. The pack is focused on the lookout tower and its surrounding props, making it easy to create and customize a lookout-themed scene. If you are looking for a complete forest environment together with the tower, the store page also points to the separate Lookout Tower Pack.

maskedbunny_huntress.description_text: Bring a mysterious and deadly presence to your game with The Masked Bunny - Huntress, a detailed game-ready character created for action, horror, fantasy, and RPG projects. Her distinctive masked design combines a unique visual identity with realistic PBR materials and a flexible modular setup, making her suitable for both gameplay and cinematic scenes. HIGHLIGHTS Unique Character Design – Distinctive masked bunny-themed huntress Modular Setup – Customize and combine character components easily ARKit Blendshapes – Ready for expressive facial animation Humanoid Rig – Designed for Unity’s humanoid animation system ️ PBR Materials – Detailed materials for realistic rendering ⚔️ Game Ready – Suitable for real-time gameplay and cinematic use Render Pipeline Support – Built-in, URP & HDRP compatible Versatile Character – Great for Action, Horror, Fantasy, RPG & Adventure projects

infernalvoidheart.description_text: Enter the darkness with Infernal Voidheart, a sinister skeletal demon character created for dark fantasy, horror, action, and RPG games. Its mysterious infernal design, detailed PBR materials, distinctive weapon, and intimidating presence make it suitable for powerful enemies, elite creatures, and boss encounters. HIGHLIGHTS Infernal Character – Dark and intimidating skeletal demon design ⚔️ Weapon Included – Ready for combat and battle scenarios Enemy & Boss Ready – Designed for powerful encounters ARKit Blendshapes – Supports expressive facial animation Detailed Skeleton – Distinctive fantasy creature appearance ️ PBR Materials – Detailed materials for realistic rendering Game Ready – Suitable for real-time gameplay Render Pipeline Support – Built-in, URP & HDRP compatible

dungeoncrawlergridcontroller.description_text: A complete, easy to use grid-based first-person dungeon crawler controller in the style of Legend of Grimrock, Dungeon Master, & Wizardry. No scripting required. Features: - Real-time or turn-based movement - Smooth movement or instant snapping to grid - Supports inclines, declines, & crouching - Free look camera - Optional head bob - Minimap - Compass - Surface system for footstep and barrier sounds - Triggers & interaction with doors, levers, stairs to other scenes, etc. - Works with Input System, legacy input manager, Rewired, etc. - Supports Input System local multiplayer. - Optional Pixel Crushers Save System integration - Complete, well-documented C# source code - All art shown in demo scene is included for use in your projects

infinitreepro_proceduralforestcreationan.human_name: InfiniTREE PRO - Procedural Forest Creation & Optimization
infinitreepro_proceduralforestcreationan.description_text: Build forests and vegetation setups with InfiniTREE PRO! This procedural forest creation and optimization tool focuses on trees, plants, grass and foliage while providing features for procedural generation and performance optimization. Create vegetation using procedural tree tools and work with elements such as leaves, plants and forest environments. The package also includes functionality related to tree cutting and chopping, allowing trees to interact with these actions. With support for Built-in, URP and HDRP listed on the store page, InfiniTREE PRO brings procedural vegetation creation and forest-related tools together inside Unity.

advancedfxcreator_decalsparticlesradiosi.human_name: Advanced FX Creator - Decals, Particles, Radiosity & Splines
advancedfxcreator_decalsparticlesradiosi.description_text: Create and control visual effects in Unity with Advanced FX Creator! The framework brings together decals, particles, mesh emission, splines, radiosity and other visual FX tools. ✨ Work with mesh particles, particle effects, ribbons and vortex-based effects while experimenting with different ways to manipulate your scene visuals. The spline system can be used as part of your effect creation workflow, while the included tools allow different visual elements to be combined together. ️ Whether you're working with particle-based visuals, mesh effects or spline-driven setups, Advanced FX Creator gives you a collection of tools for building custom effects directly inside Unity.

particledynamicmagicurpultimate_decalspa.human_name: Particle Dynamic Magic URP ULTIMATE - Decals, Particles, Radiosity & Splines
particledynamicmagicurpultimate_decalspa.description_text: ✨ Create and manipulate dynamic particles, decals and spline-based effects with Particle Dynamic Magic URP ULTIMATE! Build effects using particles, mesh emission, splines, decals and different forces such as gravity, turbulence and vortexes. The package brings together particle manipulation, dynamic decals, spline particles and other visual effects in one framework. Create effects from meshes, images and other sources, then combine different systems to create your own visual setups. ️ With tools for particles, decals, splines and dynamic effects, you can experiment with a wide range of VFX directly inside Unity's URP workflow.

utilitytools_pack1.description_text: Speed up your Unity Editor workflow with Utility Tools - Pack 1, a collection of practical tools designed to make everyday level design and GameObject management faster and easier. From inspecting object statistics to replacing objects, sorting GameObjects, and correcting transforms, these utilities help reduce repetitive editor tasks and keep your scenes organized. ️ HIGHLIGHTS ️ GameObject Stats – Quickly inspect mesh, vertex and triangle information Object Replacer – Replace objects or prefabs efficiently Sort Objects – Organize GameObjects by name or transform Transform Correction – Quickly fix and manage transforms Editor Utilities – Practical tools for everyday workflows ⚡ Workflow Focused – Reduce repetitive editor tasks Unity Editor – Designed for Unity development workflows

hellbornwarlord.description_text: Command the battlefield with Hellborn Warlord, a powerful infernal character created for dark fantasy, action, horror, and RPG games. Featuring a menacing demon-inspired design, detailed PBR materials, a distinctive weapon, and a powerful presence, this character can serve as a formidable enemy, elite warrior, or boss character in your game. HIGHLIGHTS Hellborn Design – Detailed demon-inspired fantasy warrior ⚔️ Weapon Included – Equipped with a distinctive combat weapon Boss Ready – Ideal for powerful enemies and boss encounters ARKit Blendshapes – Supports expressive facial animation Detailed Character – Realistic skeletal and creature elements ️ PBR Materials – High-quality materials for realistic visuals Game Ready – Created for real-time gameplay applications Render Pipeline Support – Built-in, URP & HDRP compatible

infernalking.description_text: Rule the underworld with Infernal King, a powerful skeletal demon character designed for fantasy, action, horror, and RPG projects. Featuring an imposing infernal design, detailed PBR materials, a dedicated weapon, and a commanding presence, this character is ideal for powerful enemies, elite warriors, and memorable boss encounters. HIGHLIGHTS Infernal Design – Powerful skeletal demon character ⚔️ Weapon Included – Designed for combat and battle sequences Boss Character – Perfect for major enemy encounters ARKit Blendshapes – Supports expressive facial animation Skeletal Design – Detailed fantasy creature appearance ️ PBR Materials – Realistic materials for detailed visuals Game Ready – Suitable for real-time gameplay Versatile Use – Great for Action, Fantasy, Horror & RPG projects

oldindustry.description_text: Create an old industrial environment with Old Industry. This 3D environment pack combines industrial and urban themes with vegetation and nature, making it centered around old factories, mills, and industrial locations. HIGHLIGHTS Industry – Industrial environment ️ Factory – Factory-focused setting ⚙️ Mill – Industrial mill environment Vegetation – Vegetation and plant elements Nature – Natural elements within the environment ️ Urban – Urban environment theme ️ Urbex – Urban exploration theme ☢️ Post-Apocalyptic – Post-apocalyptic setting

rockydesert.description_text: Create a rocky desert environment filled with rocks, desert foliage and detailed terrain. RockyDesert includes a 765 x 765 m terrain designed around a dry desert landscape, with a collection of rocks and desert vegetation ready to be placed throughout the scene. The pack includes LODs and lightmap UVs, fully dynamic lighting and customized materials. Terrain tessellation is also included for the Built-in Render Pipeline. Use the included environment elements to build rocky desert landscapes with varied terrain, rocks and foliage while keeping the setup focused on the desert theme.

infinitunesmusiccollectionb_medievalreal.human_name: InfiniTUNES Music Collection B - Medieval Real Instrument Songs
infinitunesmusiccollectionb_medievalreal.description_text: Explore another collection of medieval real-instrument music with InfiniTUNES Collection B. The package contains music tracks that can be played directly or rearranged using their individual instrument tracks, giving you different ways to combine the available music. The music is composed by Theodore Tsoukalas of the ARTnGAME team and is based on real instruments. The included InfiniTUNE system can combine individual tracks and control their volume, allowing you to create different combinations and moods from the available music parts. Use the tracks as they are or experiment with the separate instrument layers to build your own musical arrangements.

arcademonstertrucks.description_text: Add a collection of arcade-style monster trucks to your Unity project! Arcade Monster Trucks is a 3D model pack featuring 15 unique monster trucks with a low-poly art style. The vehicles are designed for Monster Truck-based games featuring jumps, flips, tricks, Monster Truck fights, or simple racing gameplay. Each vehicle uses around 5,000–6,000 triangles, with a total geometry count of around 82K triangles across the pack. The pack includes 15 base textures, with each texture sized at 512×512. Whether you're building a racing scene, stunt gameplay, or a Monster Truck-focused project, these vehicles give you a collection of different trucks to work with.

butcherandswinebrute_dualformcharacter.human_name: Butcher / Swine Brute - Dual Form Character
butcherandswinebrute_dualformcharacter.description_text: Create a terrifying enemy with Butcher / Swine Brute, a unique dual-form character built around a brutal transformation concept. Combining a sinister butcher appearance with a monstrous swine form, this character is ideal for horror, action, fantasy, and RPG projects. Its realistic design, blendshapes, animations, and modular structure provide plenty of flexibility for gameplay and cinematic applications. HIGHLIGHTS Dual Form Character – Butcher and Swine Brute forms in one asset Monster Transformation – Designed around a terrifying creature transformation Blendshapes – Supports expressive character animation Animations – Ready for dynamic gameplay and cinematic sequences Modular Setup – Flexible character components for customization ️ Realistic Materials – Detailed visuals for immersive environments Game Ready – Suitable for enemies, monsters and encounters Versatile Use – Great for Horror, Action, Fantasy & RPG projects

oceanis2021prourpwaterframework.description_text: Build detailed water and ocean environments with Oceanis 2021 Pro URP Water Framework. Designed for Unity's Universal Render Pipeline, the system focuses on ocean and water simulation with wave systems, water shading, reflections and underwater effects. Explore features such as caustics, bubbles, foam, water vortices, floating objects and volumetric lighting. The framework also includes water-related effects for lakes and other environments. With its combination of water movement, reflections and underwater visuals, Oceanis provides a collection of tools for creating ocean and water scenes within the URP workflow.

sci-fimegacity.description_text: "Create a futuristic city environment with Sci-Fi MegaCity. This 3D environment pack focuses on futuristic and science-fiction city themes, with references to cyberpunk, Neo-Tokyo, skyscrapers, suburbs, and futuristic urban settings. HIGHLIGHTS Futuristic City – Futuristic urban environment ️ City – City-focused environment Skyscrapers – Tall futuristic city structures Cyberpunk – Cyberpunk-inspired theme Neo-Tokyo – Neo-Tokyo-inspired setting Sci-Fi – Science-fiction environment ️ Suburb – Suburban city elements Future – Futuristic world setting "

particlestabilizer.description_text: ✨ Keep particle effects under control with Particle Stabilizer, a tool focused on stabilizing and managing particle behavior in Unity. The package is designed for working with particle systems and provides functionality aimed at maintaining more controlled particle movement. ️ Use it as part of your particle-effect workflow when creating visual effects that require more consistent behavior. Particle Stabilizer fits into the broader ARTnGAME collection of particle and visual-effect tools, giving you another utility for working with particle-based effects directly inside Unity.

ambientsounds_interactivesoundscapesforu.human_name: Ambient Sounds - Interactive Soundscapes for Unity 6
ambientsounds_interactivesoundscapesforu.description_text: Give your game world a more dynamic audio atmosphere with Ambient Sounds! Organize music and sound effects into Sequences and play them globally or within specific areas of your game world. Create different soundscapes for different locations, blend between regions and make audio react to Events and Requirements. You can also synchronize multiple Sequences and manage your ambient audio setup through the Ambient Sounds Manager and Monitor windows. The package also includes a library of professionally composed music and sound effects, giving you a collection of audio content to work with while building interactive soundscapes for your game.

infiniglassurp_densitybasedrefractionsan.human_name: InfiniGLASS URP - Density based refractions and Subsurface scattering
infiniglassurp_densitybasedrefractionsan.description_text: Create glass and transparent material effects with InfiniGLASS URP! This shader system focuses on density-based refraction and subsurface scattering for Unity's Universal Render Pipeline. ✨ Experiment with effects such as depth-based refraction, volumetric transparency, density fading and refraction-based visuals. The package also includes support for caustics and transparent materials such as glass and diamond-style surfaces. With its focus on refraction, transparency and subsurface scattering, InfiniGLASS provides tools for creating and adjusting glass-like visual effects directly within Unity's URP workflow.

gaiabiomesspawnerpack_sicsgames.human_name: Gaia Biomes Spawner Pack - SICS Games
gaiabiomesspawnerpack_sicsgames.description_text: Expand your Gaia environment workflow with a dedicated spawner integration for SICS Games nature and environment assets. This pack provides Gaia spawners configured for compatible SICS Games assets, making them easier to use within Gaia terrain, biome, and procedural environment workflows. HIGHLIGHTS Gaia Integration – Designed for use with Gaia SICS Games – Configured for compatible SICS Games assets Spawner Integration – Gaia spawners for the supported asset collection ⚙️ Procedural Workflow – Use supported assets with Gaia’s spawning system ️ Biome Workflow – Suitable for Gaia terrain and biome setups Asset Integration – Connects SICS Games assets with Gaia workflows

adventureandsurvival_male.description_text: Create an adventure or survival character with a modular design and a collection of equipment and props. This male character includes customized materials, ARKit blendshapes and a rigged backpack using three additional bones. The pack also includes a rifle, pistol, hunting rifle and a set of props to complement the character. A demo map is included to showcase the character and its assets. Custom shaders are provided for the supported render pipelines, while the character has a listed height of 185 cm. The pack also includes LODs for the props, giving you a collection of character and equipment assets ready to be used in adventure and survival scenes.

arcadebikephysics.description_text: ️ Ready to add arcade-style bike gameplay to your Unity project? Arcade Bike Physics is a mobile-friendly tool with a quick setup workflow. Simply provide references for the bike body and wheels, then set up your bike and start working with the included movement logic. The asset can be used for arcade bike games such as bike fights, bike shooting, or simple racing games with collectables and throwables. You can build additional functionality around the movement system according to your project needs. The package also includes an animation system for the bike rider with Inverse Kinematics. The code is documented and designed to be easy to modify, making it a practical starting point for arcade bike gameplay in Unity.

volumetricfogsrp.description_text: ️ Add volumetric fog effects to your Unity scenes with Volumetric Fog SRP. The system is designed for use with Post Processing Stack v2.0 and provides controls for height- and distance-based fog. Choose between 2D and 3D noise models to create different fog appearances and experiment with dynamic wind and atmospheric scattering effects. The system also includes sun occlusion and experimental point-light coloration for additional control over the fog. ☀️ Volumetric Fog SRP can also work alongside the Sun Shafts SRP system, making it useful for creating atmospheric scenes with volumetric lighting effects.

gaiabiomesspawnerpack_vividarts.human_name: Gaia Biomes Spawner Pack - Vivid Arts
gaiabiomesspawnerpack_vividarts.description_text: Integrate Vivid Arts nature and environment assets into your Gaia workflow with a dedicated spawner setup. This pack provides Gaia spawners configured for compatible Vivid Arts assets, making them suitable for use within Gaia terrain, biome, and procedural environment workflows. HIGHLIGHTS Gaia Integration – Designed for use with Gaia Vivid Arts – Configured for compatible Vivid Arts assets Spawner Integration – Gaia spawners for the supported asset collection ⚙️ Procedural Workflow – Use supported assets within Gaia’s spawning system ️ Biome Workflow – Suitable for Gaia terrain and biome setups Asset Integration – Connects Vivid Arts assets with Gaia workflows

luminagihdrp_real-timevoxelglobalillumin.human_name: LUMINA GI HDRP: Real-Time Voxel Global Illumination
luminagihdrp_real-timevoxelglobalillumin.description_text: Bring real-time voxel-based global illumination to your HDRP scenes with LUMINA GI! The system focuses on real-time indirect lighting using a voxel-based approach, with support for global illumination, ambient occlusion, reflections and other lighting effects. It works with HDRP and includes support for sun and mesh-shaped light sources, allowing you to experiment with dynamic lighting across your environments. The system is designed around real-time scene lighting rather than traditional baked GI workflows, giving you a flexible way to explore indirect illumination while working directly inside Unity. ✨

house-furniture.description_text: Create a fully decorated house with a detailed collection of furniture, interior elements and street props. This pack includes a complete house featuring a bedroom, cabinet, two bathrooms, attic, child room and a large living room with kitchen. The modular exterior and interior setup lets you work with the house and its individual elements, while separate doors and drawers add more detail to the interiors. Explore worn and clean demo levels, day and night lighting, two empty houses ready for decoration, background house meshes for the neighborhood, road and street props, and over 300 unique objects. The pack also includes customized materials and high quality textures for building your own residential scenes.

megastampbundle.description_text: ⛰️ Shape your Unity terrains with the Mega Stamp Bundle, a collection of 14 stamp packs containing 140 professionally designed heightmap stamps. Explore a variety of terrain shapes including canyons, mountains, craters, dunes, hills and valleys, and combine different stamps to create more complex landscapes. The stamps can be used directly with Unity Terrain Tools, Gaia and other tools that support heightmap-based terrain stamps. Each pack contains 10 different stamps, giving you a broad selection of terrain forms to experiment with when sculpting your environments. ️

particledynamicmagic2_decalsplineaiparti.human_name: Particle Dynamic Magic 2: Decal, Spline, AI Particles & dynamics
particledynamicmagic2_decalsplineaiparti.description_text: ✨ Build dynamic particle, decal and spline effects with Particle Dynamic Magic 2! The framework combines particle manipulation, dynamic decals, spline tools and AI particle features for creating interactive visual effects. Particles can be created from splines, images, meshes and other sources, while forces such as gravity, turbulence, vortexes and attraction can be used to control their behavior. The package also includes dynamic decals, ribbons, grass effects, particle shields and a large collection of ready-made effects. ️ With editor and runtime controls, you can combine different systems to create your own particle and gameplay effects.

infiniriver_fluidbasedwatersimulator.description_text: Create flowing water effects with InfiniRIVER, a fluid-based water simulator for Unity. The framework focuses on interactive water and river-style effects, with features related to water flow, ripples, caustics, refraction and planar reflections. Work with flow maps and explore different water-based setups for rivers, liquids and other flowing environments. The system also includes particle-related functionality and can be used for different fluid visuals such as water or lava. With support across Built-in, URP and HDRP compatibility listed on the store page, InfiniRIVER provides a dedicated toolkit for experimenting with dynamic fluid environments in Unity.

gaiabiomesspawnerpack_polyartstudio.human_name: Gaia Biomes Spawner Pack - Polyart Studio
gaiabiomesspawnerpack_polyartstudio.description_text: Enhance your Gaia workflow with a dedicated spawner integration for Polyart Studio nature and environment assets. This pack provides Gaia spawners configured for compatible Polyart Studio assets, allowing you to bring them into Gaia-based terrain and biome workflows with an organized and streamlined setup. HIGHLIGHTS Gaia Integration – Designed for use with Gaia Polyart Studio – Configured for compatible Polyart Studio assets Spawner Integration – Gaia spawners for the supported asset collection ⚙️ Procedural Workflow – Use supported assets within Gaia’s spawning system ️ Biome Workflow – Suitable for Gaia terrain and biome setups Asset Integration – Connects Polyart Studio assets with Gaia workflows

forestlake.description_text: Build a pine forest environment with trees, vegetation, rocks, water and terrain elements. ForestLake includes a 2 x 2 km demo map with a lake and river, giving you a natural setting to explore and build around. Vegetation and trees include wind effects, while LODs and billboards are provided for vegetation. The pack also features fully dynamic lighting, customized materials, and LOD and lightmap UVs for the included assets. With its forest landscape, water elements and vegetation setup, ForestLake provides the main environment pieces for creating a detailed pine forest scene.

abandonedcitybus_drivable.description_text: Add an abandoned city bus to your scene with drivable functionality and multiple worn-out variations. The pack includes a drivable bus with simple character controllers, along with clean, worn, moss, burnt and destroyed looks. Individual parts can be opened, while the included car randomizer allows the bus to be used in drivable or static setups. Explore the detailed engine and interior, separate glass and included LODs. The bus uses a generic design without real-world brands or logos. Custom shaders are included for the supported render pipelines, and the asset supports Realistic Car Controller Pro, Ash Vehicle Physics and NWH Vehicles.

tooneffectsmaker_specialfxcreationandcon.human_name: Toon Effects Maker: Special FX creation & control
tooneffectsmaker_specialfxcreationandcon.description_text: ✨ Create stylized special effects with Toon Effects Maker! This tool focuses on the creation and control of toon-style visual effects using particles and other effect systems. Experiment with cartoon-inspired visuals, particle effects and different combinations of special FX elements to create your own setups. The package is designed around interactive effect creation and provides tools for building and controlling effects directly inside Unity. ⚡ Whether you're working on stylized gameplay effects or experimenting with cartoon-style visuals, Toon Effects Maker gives you a dedicated environment for creating and adjusting your own effects.

littledemonandhellbrute_dualformcharacte.human_name: Little Demon / Hell Brute - Dual Form Character
littledemonandhellbrute_dualformcharacte.description_text: A high-quality game-ready character designed for developers looking for detailed visuals, flexibility, and real-time performance. This character features a fully rigged humanoid setup, realistic PBR materials, modular outfit components, and high-resolution textures for crisp surface detail. Built for a wide range of projects including Action RPGs, Horror games, Fantasy worlds, and cinematic experiences. HIGHLIGHTS Game-Ready Character – Ready to integrate into your Unity project Modular Outfit – Easily customize and mix outfit components Facial Expressions – ARKit-ready facial setup with custom expressions Humanoid Rig – Compatible with Unity humanoid animations Animations Included – Ready-to-use gameplay animations ️ 4K Textures – High-resolution PBR textures for detailed visuals Advanced Materials – Built-In, URP & HDRP compatible Optimized – Balanced for quality and real-time performance

focus_taskmanager.description_text: Keep your Unity development tasks organized with Focus - Task Manager! Focus is an editor tool designed around productivity, task management, and project organization. Create and manage tasks using Kanban boards, organize them with customizable columns, and keep your workflow in one place. ⚡ Need to quickly capture an idea? Use the task capture shortcut to create a task quickly. You can also attach Unity-related items such as GameObjects, prefabs, scenes, and scripts to cards for easier access. Search and filter your tasks with real-time search and customizable filters, while undo/redo support helps you manage changes. Built with game development workflows in mind, Focus can help organize tasks, bugs, sprints, and content-related work directly inside Unity.

giblion_anime-npr-toonscenegenerationfra.description_text: Give your Unity scenes an anime and non-photorealistic look with GIBLION! This framework focuses on NPR and toon-style scene generation, with tools and effects for creating stylized environments. ✏️ Explore features related to outlines, toon rendering, watercolor and pencil-style visuals, while working with elements such as toon water, clouds, rivers, tornadoes, grass and vegetation. The framework also includes procedural and interactive elements that can be used when building stylized scenes. Whether you're creating a colorful environment or experimenting with anime-inspired rendering, GIBLION provides a collection of tools for developing a distinctive toon-style presentation.

boardgamespack.description_text: Add a collection of board-game and tabletop-themed 3D props to your Unity project with Board Games Pack. The pack covers a range of classic games and gaming elements, including chess, backgammon, dominoes, cards, dice, Tic-Tac-Toe, Battleship, solitaire, and casino-related objects. HIGHLIGHTS ♟️ Chess – Chess pieces and related elements Backgammon – Backgammon-related elements Domino – Domino game elements Cards – Playing card elements Tic-Tac-Toe – Tic-Tac-Toe-related elements Battleship – Battleship game elements Solitaire – Solitaire-related elements Casino – Casino-themed elements Coins – Coin-related props Dice – Dice elements

gaiabiomesspawnerpack_staggartcreations.human_name: Gaia Biomes Spawner Pack - Staggart Creations
gaiabiomesspawnerpack_staggartcreations.description_text: Bring Staggart Creations nature and environment assets into your Gaia workflow with this dedicated spawner integration. The pack provides Gaia spawners configured for compatible Staggart Creations assets, helping you incorporate them into Gaia-based terrain, biome, and procedural environment workflows. HIGHLIGHTS Gaia Integration – Designed for use with Gaia Staggart Creations – Configured for compatible Staggart Creations assets Spawner Integration – Gaia spawners for the supported asset collection ⚙️ Procedural Workflow – Use supported assets within Gaia’s spawning system ️ Biome Workflow – Suitable for Gaia terrain and biome setups Asset Integration – Connects Staggart Creations assets with Gaia workflows

modernsupermarket.description_text: Create a modern supermarket environment with this detailed 3D asset pack. Modern Supermarket focuses on the everyday products and areas found in a grocery store, with a variety of elements related to food, drinks, kitchen items, storage, dairy, meat, frozen products, and more. HIGHLIGHTS Drinks – Cola, soda and other beverage-related elements Alcohol – Wine and other alcohol-related products Food – Various food and grocery elements Dairy – Dairy-related supermarket products Meat – Meat-related grocery elements ❄️ Frozen – Frozen food and products Kitchen – Kitchen-related elements Store – Supermarket and shop environment elements

ikarus_gameviewcontroller.description_text: Preview and control your Unity Game View directly while working in the editor with IKARUS! The tool was created to help preview scenes using the actual game view while adjusting the camera and lighting without entering Play Mode. Control the Main Camera using fly-through modes and adjust the main Sun Directional Light, including its position, rotation and intensity. You can also toggle the scene's Volume FX while previewing. ✨ IKARUS is designed around direct Game View control, helping you explore your scene from the perspective of the final camera while making adjustments inside the Unity Editor.

researchship.description_text: Explore a 122-meter-long research vessel filled with ship equipment, cargo and environment props. Research Ship includes a diving capsule, cargo containers, hangar, large crane, transition room and various additional props. The vessel contains over 100 unique objects and is designed around a detailed research and ocean-going ship setting. The pack features customized materials, with new and aged looks created using vertex paint. Lightmap UVs and LODs are also included for the assets. Please note that the ship does not include a complete interior. Build your own scenes around the vessel, equipment and props included in the pack.

infernalarchmage.description_text: Bring dark magic to your fantasy world with Infernal Archmage, a powerful skeletal spellcaster designed for action, RPG, horror, and fantasy projects. With an imposing infernal appearance, detailed PBR materials, and a distinctive magical character design, this asset is well suited for powerful enemies, boss encounters, dark mages, and supernatural characters. HIGHLIGHTS Infernal Mage Design – Powerful skeletal fantasy spellcaster Enemy & Boss Ready – Perfect for major magical encounters ⚔️ Weapon Included – Designed for fantasy combat scenarios ARKit Blendshapes – Supports expressive facial animation ️ PBR Materials – Realistic materials for detailed visuals Game Ready – Created for real-time gameplay Render Pipeline Support – Built-in, URP & HDRP compatible

arcadedamagesystem.description_text: Add arcade-style damage effects to your Unity projects! Arcade Damage System is a tool focused on mesh deformation through collision impacts. When an object is hit, its mesh can deform to create a visual damage effect. ⚙️ The system provides settings for controlling deformation behavior, including the radius of influence, deformation intensity, smoothness, and deformation limits. It also supports optional mesh collider updates after deformation, helping keep collision detection synchronized with the modified mesh. Use it for vehicle damage or other objects where you want collision impacts to produce visible mesh deformation.

make_a_wish.description_text:
Donations to support Make-A-Wish are made to  PayPal Giving Fund, subject to its policies.

Make-A-Wish® creates life-changing wishes for children with critical illnesses. We seek to bring every eligible child's wish to life because a wish is an integral part of a child's treatment journey. Research shows children who have wishes granted can build the physical and emotional strength they need to fight their illness. Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, Make-A-Wish is the world’s leading children’s wish-granting organization, serving children in more than 50 countries worldwide. Together, generous donors, supporters, staff and more than 40,000 volunteers, grant a wish every 17 minutes, on average, somewhere in the world. Since 1980, Make-A-Wish has granted nearly 450,000 wishes to children; more than 30,000 last year alone. For more information about Make-A-Wish International, visit worldwish.org and for more information about Make-A-Wish America, visit wish.org.

maskedbunny_hunter.description_text: A high-quality, game-ready masked hunter character designed for action, horror, fantasy, and RPG projects. Featuring a detailed realistic design, modular outfit, PBR materials, and a fully rigged humanoid setup, The Masked Bunny - Hunter is ready to bring a unique and intimidating character to your game. HIGHLIGHTS Unique Character Design – Distinctive masked bunny-themed hunter Modular Outfit – Separate components for easy customization Facial Expressions – ARKit-compatible blendshapes for expressive characters Humanoid Rig – Ready for Unity’s humanoid animation system ️ 4K PBR Textures – High-resolution textures for detailed visuals ⚔️ Game Ready – Optimized and ready for real-time gameplay Render Pipeline Support – Compatible with Built-in, URP & HDRP Versatile Use – Perfect for Action, Horror, Fantasy, RPG & Adventure games

gaiaforunity6.description_text: Build and shape your own worlds with Gaia for Unity 6! Create terrains, landscapes and environments using an intuitive world-building workflow designed for Unity. Sculpt terrain, work with heightmaps, populate your world with nature and explore tools for terrain, water, trees, grass and more. Gaia brings together procedural world-building features to help you move from an empty scene toward a complete environment. Whether you're creating mountains, forests, open landscapes or other terrain-based scenes, Gaia provides tools to help shape and develop your Unity worlds. Compatible with Built-in, URP and HDRP workflows. ✨

infernaldeathknight.description_text: Unleash a terrifying presence on the battlefield with Infernal Death Knight, a detailed game-ready character designed for dark fantasy, RPG, action, and horror projects. With its menacing skeletal design, powerful armor, detailed PBR materials, and distinctive weapon, this character is well suited for powerful enemies, elite warriors, and intimidating boss encounters. HIGHLIGHTS Detailed Character – Realistic infernal skeletal warrior design ⚔️ Weapon Included – Equipped with a powerful signature weapon ARKit Blendshapes – Ready for expressive facial animation Humanoid Character – Suitable for animation and gameplay ️ PBR Materials – Detailed textures and materials for realistic visuals Enemy & Boss Ready – Perfect for powerful enemies and boss encounters Render Pipeline Support – Built-in, URP & HDRP compatible Versatile Use – Great for Action, Fantasy, Horror & RPG projects

loveandhate.description_text: Create complex characters that react emotionally to what’s actually happening in the game. Love/Hate is a relationship & personality simulator that models characters’ feelings about each other using emotional states and value-based judgment of deeds, including actions done by the player. It uses powerful, customizable personality and emotional state models, and it tracks how different characters and groups (factions) feel about each other, allowing you to define a dynamic web of social ties among your characters. Characters witness deeds committed by others, judge them according to their own personality and relationships, remember them, and share memories realistically, allowing news of actions to spread organically. No scripting required.

modernlaboratory.description_text: Create a modern laboratory environment with this 3D asset pack. Modern Laboratory is centered around scientific and research themes, with elements and references covering chemistry, physics, optics, biology, viruses, bacteria, drugs, and other laboratory-related subjects. HIGHLIGHTS Laboratory – Modern laboratory environment ⚗️ Chemistry – Chemistry-related laboratory theme Biology – Bacteria and virus-related themes Physics & Optics – Scientific research themes Drugs – Drug-related laboratory elements Science – General scientific environment Alien – Suitable for alien-themed laboratory settings Horror & Zombie – Horror and zombie-related themes VR – Suitable for VR environments

globalilluminationproxy.description_text: Add dynamic global illumination to your Unity scenes with Global Illumination Proxy. The system is designed for real-time GI without traditional light baking and supports Unity light types such as point, spot and directional lights. It also includes features such as second light bounces, image-based lighting and area-light proxy functionality. The Hero Follow mode can be used for open environments where the GI calculation follows the main character area. ✨ With its real-time approach and support for different lighting setups, Global Illumination Proxy provides a way to experiment with dynamic indirect lighting directly in Unity.

nunandpossessednun_dualformcharacter.human_name: Nun / Possessed Nun - Dual Form Character
nunandpossessednun_dualformcharacter.description_text: Transform a mysterious figure into a terrifying possessed entity with this dual-form character. Designed for horror, fantasy, action, and RPG projects, the Nun / Possessed Nun combines a realistic character design with a dramatic possession transformation. Detailed PBR materials, facial blendshapes, and a modular setup make this character suitable for both gameplay and cinematic scenes. HIGHLIGHTS ⛪ Dual Form Character – Switch between Nun and Possessed forms Possession Transformation – Create a striking supernatural transformation ARKit Blendshapes – Supports expressive facial animation Modular Character – Customize the character setup for your project ️ PBR Materials – Detailed materials for realistic rendering Game Ready – Designed for real-time gameplay and cinematic scenes Render Pipeline Support – Built-in, URP & HDRP compatible Versatile Use – Perfect for Horror, Fantasy, Action & RPG games

oceanisprobirpwaterframework.description_text: Create water and ocean scenes in Unity's Built-in Render Pipeline with Oceanis Pro BiRP Water Framework. The system focuses on water simulation and visual effects, with features including ocean waves, foam, bubbles, caustics, water vortices and underwater effects. It also includes support for floating objects and water-related lighting effects. The framework is designed specifically for the Built-in Render Pipeline, giving you tools for developing ocean and water environments within that workflow. Combine the available water effects and settings to create different types of scenes, from open ocean environments to other liquid-based setups.

ashmonstertruckphysics.description_text: Bring monster truck physics into your Unity project! Ash Monster Truck Physics is a mobile-friendly tool designed to make setting up a Monster Truck straightforward. Simply provide references for the vehicle body and wheels and use the quick setup workflow to get your Monster Truck ready. The system is suitable for Monster Truck-based games featuring jumps, flips, tricks, Monster Truck fights, or simple racing gameplay. The asset also includes the 15 Arcade Monster Trucks Pack. ️ The code is designed to be easy to understand and modify, making it useful when you want to adjust the vehicle behavior around your own project requirements. Get your Monster Truck ready and start building your arcade-style driving gameplay!

pocketbravery.description_text:

lethalleagueblaze.description_text:
Lethal League Blaze is an intense, high speed ball game, with unique characters, outta sight sounds and none of that weak shit. In Shine City, the anti-gravity ball game has long been illegal. The group who kept playing was dubbed the Lethal League. Even now, with their sport pushed underground, players and crews compete in the League for challenge and respect.

In the game, the goal is to beat your opponents with the ball. You can manipulate the ball to get the perfect angle and use your character's special moves to surprise them. But every strike speeds up the ball or even doubles its speed, up to shatteringly extreme velocities. You can tag the ball to your color, but on those high speeds the tables are quickly turned. You can play locally with friends and foes, by yourself in the singleplayer modes or battle it out online!

Featuring

  • Up to 4 players:
    Play locally AND online with up to 4 players.
  • Easy to pick up, hard to master gameplay:
    Start off simply hitting the ball faster and faster back and forth. Improve by learning how to use Smashes, Bunts and Special Abilities to your advantage. Then go further beyond with parries and countering with throws ending with the pure psychological goodness: taunts.
  • Tons of unlockable extras and secrets:
    Unlock characters and their outfits as you play. New modes and stages are in there too and even the soundtrack can be unlocked to play at leisure.
  • Play on your own:
    Step up to the plate by yourself and beat a series of opponents in the Arcade Mode to reach the beat-blasting bossfight. Then check out the event-based Story Mode that has you playing all sides of the going-downs in Shine City.
  • Modes and options:
    Pick your preferred style of play like with HP, one-shot kill or points. And then there are game modes like Strikers, using goals, and something called Lethal Volley...
  • Wicked Tracks:
    A Breakbeat, Hip-Hop and House soundtrack featuring the likes of Hideki Naganuma, Frank Klepacki, Pixelord, Bignic and of course Klaus Veen.
Lethal League Blaze is the sequel to the popular projectile-fighting game Lethal League known for it's ridiculous speeds and hitstun, the original game was intense to watch and intenser to play. This time around there will be double the characters at launch and more to come after.

rivalsofaetherii.description_text:
Rivals of Aether II is the next generation of platform fighters and multiplayer brawlers. This sequel to the hit indie fighting game Rivals of Aether is expanded and upgraded with 3D visuals, new mechanics, improved online support, and more!

The Aether Universe is a world where warring civilizations summon the power of Fire, Water, Air, and Earth - and powerful Rivals harness those powers to clobber each other! Rivals of Aether II continues the franchise’s iconic focus on competitive depth, accessible gameplay, and unforgettable characters. Whether you’re a competitive master of the genre or a newcomer looking to have fun, Rivals of Aether II delivers a fast-paced and flashy brawler experience that you won’t forget.

Rivals of Aether II features an exciting base roster of new and returning characters - with post-launch plans to add additional playable characters to the game for free! Each of these playable Rivals have an expansive moveset featuring new mechanics and special moves that are not only an upgrade over the original game, but new to the platform fighter genre as a whole. Shields, ledges, grabs and throws add new layers to the frenetic flow of combat in Rivals of Aether II . divekick.description_text:
Divekick is the world’s first two-button fighting game. It distills the essence of the fighting game genre into just two buttons with no d-pad directional movement. Divekick’s focused gameplay demonstrates how much depth a single move actually has, and introduces (or reinforces) skills fundamental to the genre: mind games, spacing, timing, and quick reactions.

At Iron Galaxy we love fighting games. To the average fan, most of what makes them fun is hidden behind a never-ending series of input combinations that they have to memorize. That’s why Divekick has just two buttons: Dive (into the air) makes your character jump straight up. Kick causes your character to fly foot first at a downward angle. If you press Kick on the ground, you can jump away from your opponent. Utilizing these moves, the first hit will win the round, and the player that wins five rounds first wins the game. It’s pure adrenaline, awareness, and outsmarting your enemy. It’s a fighting game deconstructed into its purest form.

Key Features

  • 14+ Completely unique and original characters, each with their own fighting style and special techniques. 
  • Includes two extra playable characters: Fencer from Nidhogg and Johnny Gat from Saints Row!
  • A story for every character in the game, including an intro, ending, and rival battles. You will be moved to tears!
  • Ranked and non-ranked GGPO-powered online multiplayer, the most trusted netcode in fighting games.  Includes ranking boards for each character, as well as overall.
  • Single player plus Local VS multiplayer for two players, with quick and easy button reconfiguration to accommodate a room full of unique personalities.
  • Full Steamworks integration, including Big Picture Mode.

rivalsofaether.description_text:
Overview

RIVALS OF AETHER is an indie fighting game set in a world where warring civilizations summon the power of Fire, Water, Air, and Earth. Choose a Rival to bring into the battlefield and manipulate the powers of the classical elements and animal movement. Praised for its competitive gameplay and intensive training tools, Rivals of Aether is the perfect entry to the Platform Fighter genre.

Game Features

  • Choose VERSUS MODE to duke it out in competitive 1v1 or 2v2 fights, or jump into a free-for-all.
  • Play STORY MODE to learn the backstory behind each rival and begin to uncover the hidden mysteries of Aether.
  • Dive into ABYSS MODE to see how many waves of shadowy fighters you can defeat and reach the leaderboards alone or with a friend. Customize your Abyss Mode builds and challenge your friends in ABYSS VERSUS.
  • Take your skills online in ONLINE VERSUS ! Play against your friends or test your skills in RANKED MODE to climb the leaderboard.
  • Study TUTORIAL MODE to hone your skills from beginner to advanced lessons. Or boot up PRACTICE MODE to get your hands on all the frame data and hitbox visualizations.

Rivals

Zetterburn, a son of the ruling family of the Firelands, is an experienced and hardened warrior. In battle, Zetterburn uses no weapons except for his razor-sharp claws and ability to control flame.

  • BURN DAMAGE - Zetterburn's special attacks can set opponents on fire, causing them additional damage over time.
  • WILD FIRE - Zetterburn's Down Special places flames on the stage. These flames stay for a period of time, burning any opponents who come in contact with them.
  • FIRE AMP - When an opponent is burning, Zetterburn's Strong Attacks can absorb the flames and launch the burned enemy twice as far, making for an effective killing blow.

Orcane is a playful trickster, notorious for escaping even the most precarious of situations. He can transform into water and confuse enemies with a spray of bubbles.

  • PUDDLE TELEPORTATION - Orcane creates a puddle with his Neutral Special or Down Special. He can then teleport to his puddle using his Up Special as a powerful vertical blow or an effective recovery when launched off the stage.
  • BUBBLE EVAPORATION - Orcane can turn his puddle into a pillar of bubbles with his Down Special to trap enemies above the puddle.
  • WATER AMP - When standing on top of his puddle, Orcane can consume the water underneath him to perform powerful Strong Attacks with far greater range and knockback.

The youngest trainee in the history of the Air Academy, Wrastor has never lived by anyone's rules but his own. Currently an Aerial Ace for the Air Armada, Wrastor is wrecking havoc among the Armada's enemies and generals alike.

  • WINGED FLIGHT - Wrastor can jump 4 times, making him incredible at controlling the air and recovering from the toughest falls even when things look grim.
  • WIND CURRENT - Wrastor can create a Wind Current with his Forward Special, allowing him to move faster within it and chase his targets more effectively.
  • AERIAL ACE - Wrastor performs his charged Strong Attacks in the air instead of on the ground, a first for this genre.

Kragg is a defender of the colossal Aetherian Forest. Deliberate and loyal, he is one of the infamous Wall Runners who patrol the Rock Wall. Unlike other Wall Runners, Kragg has the legendary ability to control the earth with his will.

  • ROCK HURL - Kragg can pull a rock out of the ground and hurl it at opponents. After it leaves his hands, the rock becomes a solid piece of stage that either Kragg or other players can break.
  • DEFENSE BALL - Kragg can curl into a ball and roll toward enemies. Although he can be damaged while in ball form, he cannot be knocked away.
  • EARTH PILLAR - Kragg can summon a pillar of earth to his feet regardless of where he is. If Kragg is about to fall to his death, this move can quickly turn his situation around.

Forsburn is the disgraced, eldest son of the Firelands' ruling family. After being condemned by the Fire Council and his own brother, Forsburn found refuge in a group of outsiders who had rejected the flame and mastered the way of smoke.

  • SMOKE SCREEN - Forsburn can use his Neutral Special to obscure the battlefield allowing Forsburn to remain hidden inside a cloud of smoke.
  • DECOY - Through his Forward Special, Forsburn can create a smoke facsimile of himself that can attack opponents. The illusory Forsburn breaks into smoke after being hit by a single attack.
  • CONSUME/COMBUST - By using his Down Special, Forsburn can consume his smoke clouds back into his body. After consuming three clouds, Forsburn is charged up and can use Down Special again to combust: knocking opponents away at high speed.

Maypul is the self-appointed Guardian of the Aetherian Forest. She commands fearful respect throughout the forest for her unhesitating vigilantism. She uses her agility to trap any unknown intruders before they even realize she is there.

  • WATCHER'S MARK - Maypul can use her Seeds or her Watcher's Dash to mark opponents, making them susceptible to her following attacks.
  • WRAPPED UP - After marking her targets, Maypul can use her Strong Attacks or her trusty Plant to wrap marked opponents in place allowing her to follow up with another attack.
  • SLING SHOT - Maypul can use her vines to sling toward marked opponents, allowing her to elude attacks and quickly close distances.

Absa is a famed engineer and martialist of the Elders of the Air Alliance. Despite the laws of the Elders, Absa secretly developed storm techniques in the caves of the Archai mountains.

  • CLOUD CONTROL - Absa can place a cloud using her Neutral or Forward Special. This cloud hangs in the air until Absa bursts it by tapping her Neutral Special and knocking enemies away.
  • THUNDER BOLT - Absa can charge her Neutral Special to create a powerful lightning blast that connects her to her cloud. All opponents caught between the two will be knocked away at high speeds.
  • CONDENSED STORM - Absa focuses the power of a lightning bolt to the tip of her hoof. If she can line up one of her aerial kicks perfectly, she unleashes great power.

Etalus is a legendary warrior in his native land. He is one of the last surviving members of the Harbor Guard and uses the power of ice to augment his massive strength.

  • HOME ICE ADVANTAGE: Etalus can use his Forward Special or Forward Tilt to freeze the ground beneath him in order to slide across on the icy surface.
  • ARMORED UP: When standing on ice, Etalus can use his Neutral Special to absorb the ice and create ice armor around his body.
  • AVALANCHE: Etalus can use his Down Special to shatter all nearby ice, instantly freezing any enemies who are standing on it.

completejavadevelopercourse_frombeginner.description_text: Be it websites, mobile apps, or desktop software, Java remains one of the most popular programming languages around. With over 7.6 million developers using it worldwide, the surge of new programming languages has not dampened the demand for this 25+-year-old language. With an average Java developer in the US earning over $104,000 a year, Java programming skills are still highly sought after. This course is designed to teach you these skills from scratch, starting with JDK installation followed by the creation of your first program. Then, as you progress through the sections, you’ll start learning the core Java concepts such as control statements, arrays, strings, methods, objects, and more. In each of these sections, you’ll be building a unique, exciting project, thus ensuring you’re not just learning the theory but also practicing what you learned. Average of three, Mad Libs clone, and tic-tac-toe are just some of the projects you’ll be building in this course. To make sure you’ve mastered each line of code, there are practical hands-on coding challenges in every lecture. By the end of this course, you will have mastered the best tips, tricks, and theory behind the Java programming language. The hands-on nature of this course will ensure that you can readily apply your skills to real-world projects.

designandimplementciandcdpipelinesusingj.human_name: Design & Implement CI/CD Pipelines using Jenkins - Hands-On
designandimplementciandcdpipelinesusingj.description_text: This course introduces the fundamentals of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery and explains how automated pipelines streamline development, testing, and deployment workflows. You will begin by exploring the core principles of CI/CD and understanding how automation improves collaboration and accelerates release cycles in modern development environments. The learning journey then shifts to Jenkins, one of the most widely used automation servers for implementing CI/CD pipelines. Through guided demonstrations, you will install Jenkins in different environments, explore its architecture, and navigate its interface. You will create Jenkins jobs, configure build triggers, automate testing processes, and integrate source code repositories such as Git and GitHub. You will also learn how plugins, agents, and nodes support scalable build automation. The course then moves into pipeline-based automation. You will design multi-stage pipelines and integrate tools such as Docker and Ansible to support automated deployments. Advanced topics such as credential management, conditional stages, and parallel execution will help you build efficient pipelines and implement practical DevOps automation workflows.
